name: app-dark-lime-ui-kit-colour-icons-and-type-board
title: Dark Lime UI Kit Colour, Icons and Type
whatItIs: A dark board with rounded panels: colour swatches (pale lime, cotton seed, raisin black, mid grey, outer space), a strip of fitness UI, a grid of lime line icons, font specimens for Plus Jakarta Sans and Jost, and a type scale table.
whatItMeans: Lime on charcoal is energetic and sporty, and the grid of tiles documents the whole system in one look.
techniques: Swatches as large rounded tiles with names and hex
Line icon grid in the accent colour
Type scale table with sizes and sample labels
Lime used for all text on dark

vocabulary.definition: A sheet documenting colour, icons and type.
A ladder of sizes and weights for each text role.
A faint oversized glyph behind text.
